evaluation_role: External development comparison on GSE183947. The cohort is not the paper's GSE45498 cohort; the paper-reported gamma is tested for transport. The automatic-versus-fixed gamma pair isolates bandwidth under the same lambda search; the fixed gamma+lambda run separately tests the reported pair.
